observations: Photo 0 shows a red cruiser-style motorcycle parked on a brick patio, with a grey wall and barbed wire in the background. The bike has chrome exhaust pipes, a black seat, and a visible engine. The front wheel and handlebars are visible, and the rear tire appears worn.

Photo 1 shows the rear view of the same motorcycle, focusing on the tail light, rear tire, and exhaust. The rear tire shows significant tread wear, especially on the center. The seat is black and appears to be in good condition. The bike has a red body with a white stripe on the fuel tank.
No visible brand or model badges are readable in either photo. The seller claims it is a Suzuki M109r 1800cc, but no such text is visible on the bike in the photos.
The motorcycle appears to be in decent cosmetic condition, but the rear tire shows signs of use, contradicting the 'super clean new arrival' claim.
The odometer reading is not visible in either photo, so the 'less than 3800km mileage' claim cannot be verified.
